{{MultipleIssues|citation|moresources}}
{{Quote|I do not talk to terrorists and insurgents.|An Imperial recruiter|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
[[File:Raid_on_the_Mummer_bunker.jpg|thumb|right|230px|A group of [[Mummers|Mummer]] terrorists.]]
'''Terrorists''' were those who engaged in '''terrorism''', the use of violence and threats to intimidate or coerce, especially for [[Politics/Legends|political]] purposes.

==History==
[[File:Memorial_Shrine_bombing.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A terrorist [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|bombing]] by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], some, including [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], considered the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to be terrorists.<ref>[[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars 10'']]</ref>

Several groups were considered terrorist groups by various governments. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] widely branded the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] as terrorists, mostly for [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] reasons.

Meanwhile, the Empire embraced the [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Tarkin Doctrine]]&mdash;the use of fear of overwhelming force to create a climate of fear and obedience&mdash;making it an equal practitioner of state terrorism, as epitomised by the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] and its deployment against various unarmed civilians and even pacifist [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

The [[Corellian Security Force]] considered the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] to be a terrorist organization for planting explosives in various [[City/Legends|cities]], but only next to the machinery they despised.

[[Mummers|Terrorists]] were also known to [[Terrorist attack in Theed|place bombs]] in the eastern part of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], much to the annoyance of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:HwtaotTa">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=class|Legacy|Help with the aftermath of the Terrorist attack|Naboo}}</ref>
